decisions.reason: A startup accelerator is peripheral to the firm's machinery core and generates little revenue, so problemistic search and resource refocusing make it the likeliest candidate to be quietly discontinued.

The bio-based bitumen binder is a flagship that signals strategic direction, and the firm is growing, so slack lets management carry it despite uncertain market results, though its distance from the core plant business adds risk.
The infectious waste plant is close to the core offer, is backed by a partnership with ERMAFA and featured as a flagship, so it is likely to stay while results are evaluated against aspirations.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the established WASTX modular line with low incremental cost and fits the decentralized strategy, so there is little reason to drop it.
